note: Where this repository's deploy job (.github/workflows/next-deploy.yml, scripts/hosting/deploy.mjs) and promote.py may publish (fm-6fx6). Exactly one repository publishes a target at a time. scripts/hosting/publish-guard.mjs refuses, before any network call, a target the repository variable FACEMORPH_PUBLISH_TARGETS does not name, a target marked classicOwned, and any target sharing a Worker, bucket or host with a classicOwned one. The candidate-source handover (fm-s3o, 27 October 2026) moved next here: next is no longer classicOwned and classic next-site.yml is disabled. production stays classicOwned until the operator's promotion decision (fm-fy2.12).

staging.purpose: Test target for the deploy dry run: a workers.dev site and its test mirror. Holds only published runtime and artifact bytes; never user data.

control.purpose: The pinned classic control (autoresearch/drivers/control.json), live, so release.yml's live job measures each phone cell on it straight after the candidate on the same phone and link (operator, 28 October 2026). Deployed by release.yml site=control; never a candidate, never user data.

next.purpose: next.facemorph.me and its runtime mirror; published only by this repository since the candidate-source handover (fm-s3o); classic next-site.yml is disabled.

production.purpose: facemorph.me, still classic's legacy Vercel deploy (deploy.yml); production promotion is a separate operator decision (fm-fy2.12). promotionWorker names the Worker facemorph.me will route to after promotion; it is this repository's next Worker and not a classic-owned identity today. Promotion adds it back as the site worker.
